# Getting started

![](https://www.ayoba.me/web/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fayoba-website-content-dev.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com%2Fayoba-website-dev%2FGroup_1595_6d4fe62d70.png&w=3840&q=75)

![icon](https://ayoba-website-content-dev.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/ayoba-website-dev/icon_download_257a33fbee.svg)

### Download

Ayoba is available as a Free Download via the Google Play Store or Apple AppStore. Are you an MTN user? We have a free download of the app for you on this [website](https://www.ayoba.me/web).

![](https://ayoba-website-content-dev.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/ayoba-website-dev/bg_Svg01_26277bd848.svg)

![](https://www.ayoba.me/web/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fayoba-website-content-dev.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com%2Fayoba-website-dev%2FRegister_Resize_daa9931886.png&w=3840&q=75)

![icon](https://ayoba-website-content-dev.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/ayoba-website-dev/icon_register_c3db5f7a4d.svg)

### Register & Sign up

Once you have downloaded the app, you’ll need to Register. We will ask you a few simple questions to ensure that we verify your identity, and can enable safe and secure chats and calls.

Register to ayoba in a few short steps:

1. Select your preferred language
2. Type in your number
3. Wait for your code which will be sent via SMS
4. Type in your code
5. Allow ayoba to access to your contacts

![](https://ayoba-website-content-dev.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/ayoba-website-dev/bg_Svg02_7a77a4cad7.svg)

![](https://www.ayoba.me/web/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fayoba-website-content-dev.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com%2Fayoba-website-dev%2FMask_Group_1a01f19c47.png&w=3840&q=75)

![icon](https://ayoba-website-content-dev.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/ayoba-website-dev/icon_enjoy_9575fa3fb6.svg)

### Enjoy

Enjoy chatting, calling, sharing, listening, playing and more!

![](https://ayoba-website-content-dev.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/ayoba-website-dev/bg_Svg03_b661527173.svg)

business_profile.structured_content:
# Ayoba: All-in-One App

Ayoba is an all-in-one app that offers chat, call, share, play, listen, watch, and more.

**Key Features:**

*   **Free Data:** No data cost for MTN subscribers (excluding Benin). Standard data charges apply otherwise.
*   **Availability:** Available for free download on the Google Play Store, AppStore (iOS), and Huawei App Gallery.
*   **TikTok Integration:** Direct integration of TikTok content within the ayoba app.

## Key Features

*   **Chat:** Free instant messaging to all contacts, even if they don't have the app.
*   **Call:** Voice and video calls.
*   **Share:** Share voice notes, pictures, and files.
*   **Content:** Access to sports, fashion, beauty, news, comedy, health, entertainment, education, and empowerment content. Updated daily in English, French, Arabic, and select local languages.
*   **Music:** Free access to a music player with daily updates on international and African music, including afrobeats, amapiano, gospel, and pop. Playlists are set up for each territory.
*   **Games:** Wide variety of interactive games, including action, adventure, and children's games.
*   **MTN Mobile Money (MoMo):** Check balances and send/receive money securely within the app (available in Ghana, Uganda, Congo B, and Cameroon).
*   **Mini Apps:** Access a range of content and services, including streaming channels and podcasts. Availability may vary per country.

## Getting Started

1.  **Download:** Download the ayoba app from the [Google Play Store](https://i.ayo.ba/aJBy?pid=organic&c=organic), [AppStore (iOS)](https://i.ayo.ba/Lqeg?pid=organic&c=organic), or [Huawei App Gallery](https://i.ayo.ba/wq8W?pid=organic&c=organic).
2.  **Register:**
    *   Select your preferred language.
    *   Enter your phone number.
    *   Enter the code sent via SMS.
    *   Allow ayoba to access your contacts.
